main.description: Same-origin, no-server-key auth gate for etzhayyim.com/profile (ADR-2606060000). VERIFIES a member-signed CACAO (CAIP-74) and returns the resolved DID + capability scope so the page can flip into edit-mode WITHOUT a separate auth.etzhayyim.com hop and WITHOUT the Worker holding any key. Three sign-in methods converge on one CACAO: WebAuthn/passkey → Ed25519 did:key (`EdDSA`, verified locally via WebCrypto); wallet/SIWE → did:pkh:eip155 (`eip191`, secp256k1/ERC-1271 recovery delegated to the kotoba node). This is NOT the write-authorization point — the profile mutation is a CACAO-authorized datom:transact to kotoba, whose NonceStore enforces single-use replay protection.

cacao.description: The member-signed CACAO. Wire shape is byte-identical to kotoba-auth `Cacao { h, p, s }`.

valid.description: True iff the signature verified locally (EdDSA). False with `gated=true` means structurally valid but signature-verify must run on the kotoba node (eip191).

gated.description: eip191 only — recovery delegated to kotoba.

errors.name: MalformedCacao
errors.description: The CACAO is missing or structurally invalid.

errors.name: WrongAudience
errors.description: The CACAO audience/domain is not bound to etzhayyim.com (anti-cross-site).

errors.name: NoCapability
errors.description: The CACAO grants no kotoba://op/ capability resource.

errors.name: SignatureInvalid
errors.description: The signature did not verify against the issuer key.

cacao.description: CAIP-74 Chain-Agnostic Capability Authorization Object (mirror of kotoba-auth/src/cacao.rs).

aud.description: Audience — must bind to did:web:etzhayyim.com or https://etzhayyim.com.

exp.description: Expiry, strict UTC ISO-8601 `Z` (fail-safe expired if malformed).

nonce.description: Single-use nonce (enforced at the kotoba write layer).

s.description: Signature — hex (0x-prefixed or bare) or base64.

scope.description: The granted capability scope echoed back for the client to gate its UI.

graphs.description: kotoba://graph/<cid> scopes the capability is bound to.
